heading: Small claims for privately owned property damage or loss

tree.text: The head of an agency (except a military department of the Department of Defense or the Coast Guard) may settle a claim for not more than $1,000 for damage to, or loss of, privately owned property that—

children.text: is caused by the negligence of an officer or employee of the United States Government acting within the scope of employment; and
may not be settled under chapter 171 of title 28.

tree.text: A claim under this section may be allowed only if it is presented to the head of the agency within one year after it accrues.

A claim under this section may be paid as provided in section 1304 of this title only if the claimant accepts the amount of the settlement in complete satisfaction of the claim against the Government.

notes.text: For transfer of authorities, functions, personnel, and assets of the Coast Guard, including the authorities and functions of the Secretary of Transportation relating thereto, to the Department of Homeland Security, and for treatment of related references, see sections 468(b), 551(d), 552(d), and 557 of Title 6, Domestic Security, and the Department of Homeland Security Reorganization Plan of November 25, 2002, as modified, set out as a note under section 542 of Title 6.
